Capability statement · September 2026

Fluid Investment Group LLC

Commercial technology products, software implementation and technical operations.

Company overview

A US operating and venture company based in Ocala, Florida. Fluid builds and operates technology products, with Kids Call Home as its flagship venture, and is available for government contracting and teaming discussions.

Core capabilities

Web and cross-platform product development; backend systems and integrations; authentication and subscription systems; deployment, distribution and ongoing product operation.

Commercial evidence

Kids Call Home: parent-managed family communication across mobile, web and desktop. The Apple App Store identifies Fluid Investment Group LLC as the seller. Fluid has not yet won a federal contract. This is commercial product evidence, not federal past performance.
